name: Senthil Infotek Limited
about: Senthil Infotek Limited engages in the information technology industry in India. It offers e-commerce applications and e-commerce product implementation; on-site staff supplementation, such as IT professionals for on-site support; LAN, WAN, and VPN solutions; web-based solutions; and data warehousing solutions. The company was formerly known as Senthil Agrotech Limited and changed its name to Senthil Infotek Limited in February 2000. Senthil Infotek Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Secunderabad, India.
